A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
notification is an important tool for awareness, but it is not the only one, nor does it always suffice.
notification systems need to provide awareness of the collaborative situation and activity context.
we need to design systems that support awareness and notification for the collaborative activity, not just for the individual user.
The main takeaway from our work is that
awareness systems should provide more information to the user, and provide it in a more structured way.
notification systems can and should be more than just a mechanism to notify users of events; they should also support users in their collaborative activity.
activity awareness is a useful concept for understanding and designing for collaborative activity.
